name: cTSPersistCacheStrategyGenerational::Evict (vf23)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). Slot 23 (ret 0xc): Evict(levels, force, budget). Without force nothing happens while count <= limit (al 0, tick unchanged). Otherwise generations 0..min(levels,4)-1 are walked, at most `budget` entries each (out of budget the rest of the list is rotated to the front). Resources with fewer than 2 uses (slot 11) are restamped if recent and evicted when forced or older than the table's minimum age: index entry erased (by key, or a scan for every entry naming the node), resource released, node and count dropped; without force the walk stops (tick advanced, al 1) once count <= limit. Other entries are marked recent if in use and, in generations 0..2, aged: at the table's threshold (+0x18 + 4g, low byte) moved to the back of the next generation and re-indexed by their key. Advances the tick; al = anything evicted.
